title: Condensation in every dilute hard-sphere ground state
exact_target: Are there absolute $\epsilon _0,c_0>0$ such that for every $a,\rho >0$ with rho $a^3<\epsilon _0$, every thermodynamic sequence N,L$\to$infinity with $N/L^3\to \rho $, and every normalized bosonic hard-sphere ground eigenvector, the limiting lower condensate fraction is at least $c_0$?
